```yaml
name: Update Meeting Minutes

on:
  schedule:
    # Runs every day at 08:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 8 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  update-meeting-minutes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install axios

      - name: Fetch and Update Meeting Minutes
        id: fetch-minutes
        env:
          DISCOURSE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.DISCOURSE_API_KEY }}
          DISCOURSE_USER: ${{ secrets.DISCOURSE_USER }}
        run: |
          # Create the archive directory if it doesn't exist
          mkdir -p .github/meetings/archive

          # Fetch the latest topic from the community category (category ID 5 is typically community, adjust if necessary)
          # We use the Discourse API to get the latest topic in the community category
          LATEST_TOPIC_JSON=$(curl -s -X GET "https://discuss.layer5.io/categories/5.json" \
            -H "Api-Key: $DISCOURSE_API_KEY" \
            -H "Api-Username: $DISCOURSE_USER")

          # Extract the latest topic ID
          LATEST_TOPIC_ID=$(echo $LATEST_TOPIC_JSON | jq -r '.latest_topic_id')

          if [ -z "$LATEST_TOPIC_ID" ] || [ "$LATEST_TOPIC_ID" == "null" ]; then
            echo "No new topics found or API error."
            exit 0
          fi

          # Fetch the post content
          POST_JSON=$(curl -s -X GET "https://discuss.layer5.io/t/$LATEST_TOPIC_ID.json" \
            -H "Api-Key: $DISCOURSE_API_KEY" \
            -H "Api-Username: $DISCOURSE_USER")

          # Extract title and raw post content
          TITLE=$(echo $POST_JSON | jq -r '.title')
          RAW_CONTENT=$(echo $POST_JSON | jq -r '.post_stream.posts[0].raw')
          CREATED_AT=$(echo $POST_JSON | jq -r '.created_at')
          
          # Format date for filename (YYYY-MM-DD)
          DATE=$(date -d "$CREATED_AT" +%Y-%m-%d 2>/dev/null || date -j -f "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z" "$CREATED_AT" +%Y-%m-%d 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown-date")
          
          # Sanitize title for filename
          SAFE_TITLE=$(echo "$TITLE" | tr ' ' '-' | tr -cd '[:alnum:]-')
          
          FILENAME=".github/meetings/archive/${DATE}-${SAFE_TITLE}.md"

          # Check if file already exists to avoid duplicate commits
          if [ -f "$FILENAME" ]; then
            echo "File $FILENAME already exists. Skipping."
            exit 0
          fi

          # Create the markdown file
          echo "# $TITLE" > "$FILENAME"
          echo "" >> "$FILENAME"
          echo "**Date:** $CREATED_AT" >> "$FILENAME"
          echo "" >> "$FILENAME"
          echo "$RAW_CONTENT" >> "$FILENAME"

          echo "Created file: $FILENAME"

      - name: Commit and Push Changes
        if: steps.fetch-minutes.outcome == 'success'
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add .github/meetings/archive/
          git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "docs: update meeting minutes from Discourse"
          git push origin HEAD:main
```
